rationale: CRM exposes updated_at/current rows and late commits are possible, but no hard-delete feed exists.
known_limitations: SCD history would only represent captured observations, not every source mutation.

rationale: Debezium c/u/d records are retained in Kafka and consumed in topic/partition/offset order.
known_limitations: Real Kafka consumer seek/commit and broker retention remain environment integration responsibilities.

rationale: Delta Change Data Feed exposes insert/delete/update pre/post images by commit version.
known_limitations: CDF retention must cover the next unapplied commit version.
Multiple logical mutations for one key inside one commit are rejected when order cannot be proven.

rationale: Partner API exposes changed customer records behind a replayable cursor and bounded changed_at window.
known_limitations: Delete and history fidelity depend on the partner API contract.
Cursor retention/expiry must be monitored by the source adapter.

rationale: Versioned daily files are complete account snapshots and are processed through snapshot semantics.
known_limitations: File path alone is not accepted as immutable identity; version token/checksum is required.
History is limited to delivered snapshot cadence.
